mentions.name: Sprout Vision
mentions.description: This product uses AI to generate comprehensive go-to-market strategy plans (500+ pages) for launching a new venture, aimed at people with a tech background but limited GTM experience.
mentions.problem: Tech-focused founders often have limited go-to-market experience when launching a new venture.
mentions.audience: Founders and entrepreneurs launching their next venture
mentions.source_excerpt: https://sprout.vision/ - AI generated Go-To-Market Strategy for launching your next venture. I have a Tech background with limited GTM experience, so I experimented with AI to learn about different strategies and decided to turn it into a simple product that will generate a comprehensive plan (500+ pages) to help you launch your next venture.
